content: Empty states in mobile apps: Best practices include (1) explain why screen is empty, (2) use simple on-brand illustrations, (3) include ONE clear CTA with action-oriented language, (4) keep message short (1-2 sentences), (5) friendly/encouraging tone, (6) educate about feature value. Common patterns: Onboarding/first-use, no results, no data, error states. Notable examples: Slack (illustration + CTA), Trello (clean illustration + button), Notion (templates/examples). For voice-first apps: animated microphone illustration communicates the core action immediately. Dual CTAs (Record + Write Note) give choice without overwhelming.
